decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment lies far from the core maritime offer, so it is the most likely target if search turns toward freeing resources, but it uses the existing crewing and recruitment infrastructure at low marginal cost, and a large firm's slack lets management carry it for now.

Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's seafarer network and crewing competence, has stayed visible for two years, and puts little strain on resources, so there is no shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The Smart Academy launched in April 2024 has its own page and extends the established training centres, so it is too early to judge it against aspirations and it fits the firm's strategic direction.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services sit close to the core business and answer growing regulatory demand from EU ETS and FuelEU, so they are likely to meet aspirations and support the integrated-solutions strategy.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the PAL ship management software, so it costs little to maintain and serves client compliance needs that became mandatory in 2025.
The FuelEU cost simulator is embedded in PAL alongside the dashboard and helps clients plan for compliance, so it is cheap to keep and complements the emissions services portfolio.
